headline: Joey's Best Cards
title: Joey's Best Cards in Yu-Gi-Oh | Top 5 Explained
video_script: Here are Joey Wheeler's best cards. Number 5: Red-Eyes Black Dragon, his ace card. Number 4: Jinzo, which shuts down Trap Cards, and was his Deck Master in the virtual world. Number 3: Time Wizard, a coin toss that can wipe your opponent's monsters. Number 2: Flame Swordsman, a classic Fusion Monster. Number 1: and Gilford the Lightning, tribute three monsters to summon it and destroy all your opponent's monsters. Whose deck should I cover next? Comment below!

joke: Joey's deck has more plot armour than my whole collection.
